limitations: Any-type diabetes is not T2D; normoglycemia is not general metabolic health.

Publication matches use the same underlying survey, not an independent holdout.
No national engine initialization, dietary causal effect, clinical hazard, health forecast or scientific release is accepted.

nhanes_glycemic_2021_2023.publication_citation: Gwira JA, Fryar CD, Gu Q. Prevalence of Total, Diagnosed, and Undiagnosed Diabetes in Adults: United States, August2021-August2023. NCHS Data Brief516. November2024. Tables1-2, crude estimates.
nhanes_glycemic_2021_2023.publication_match_rule: Exact sample sizes and half a one-decimal display unit (0.05 percentage point), a derived formatting check only; no fit to force agreement.
nhanes_glycemic_2021_2023.publication_target_uncertainty: Published95% confidence limits and displayed standard errors retained; no Gaussian likelihood or exact source covariance inferred.
nhanes_glycemic_2021_2023.uncertainty: Joint Taylor covariance across complete-case and eligible-population denominator families, overlapping age/sex domains and compatible-category bounds. nhanes_glycemic_2021_2023.unit: Category proportions in fraction; sampling covariance in fraction squared; publication comparisons in percent
